Core Metrics

The Functional Confidence Index

Academic marks show what a student knows. The Functional Confidence Index (FCI) measures if they can confidently use what they know in real settings.

FCI
Expression
Initiative
Collaboration
Self-Regulation
Persistence
Adaptability
Problem Solving
INDICATOR // EXPRESSION

Expression & Articulation

Measures a student's public communication effectiveness, clarity of thought delivery, and ability to defend ideas in collaborative debate frameworks.

INDICATOR // INITIATIVE

Initiative & Agency

Tracks how students take charge of unstructured tasks, identify project bottlenecks, and mobilize resources voluntarily in practical learning environments.

INDICATOR // COLLABORATION

Collaboration & Team Dynamics

Evaluates peer-to-peer delegation, active listening, conflict resolution, and the student's operational output when working inside multi-role teams.

INDICATOR // SELF-REGULATION

Self-Regulation

Measures emotional resilience, task focus, time management, and the student's ability to maintain productivity under stressful scenarios.

INDICATOR // PERSISTENCE

Persistence & Grit

Tracks how a student handles challenges, measuring retry rates, failure tolerance, and problem investigation loops when encountering complex barriers.

INDICATOR // ADAPTABILITY

Adaptability & Pivot Velocity

Assesses the speed and quality of changes in approach when initial project hypotheses fail or parameters shift mid-way.

INDICATOR // PROBLEM SOLVING

Problem-Solving Confidence

Measures confidence in analyzing unfamiliar situations, dividing large problems into logical tasks, and building structured solutions.
